QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_26

question.text: Under the change-of-control exit mechanism for a CLOSE-ENDED Cat III AIF, the exit price for dissenting investors is:

answer.text: Not less than the average of two independent valuations

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI Circular (June-2014, subsumed into Master Circular 31-July-2023) mandates that prior to buyout of dissenting investors' units, valuation is done by 2 independent valuers; the exit price is NOT LESS THAN the AVERAGE of the two valuations. The Trap: NAV (A) is ambiguous in close-ended illiquid contexts. Book value (B) ignores market value. Hurdle-plus-subscription (D) is Cat I/II waterfall language — wrong. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C / XIX-D test the same two-valuer / average rule across categories. Manager's Pro-Tip: Retain valuers with capacity to deliver valuation within a month; the 3-month exit completion deadline (from last date of dissent) starts ticking fast. Manager pays valuer fees — NOT charged to unit holders.
